node.statement: The verifier challenge ch-28d9a8291aee33f7 is correct: with H=(Ha^Q_{P,R})_n(Z)X, def-ha-map gives the well-typed identity 2*<Y,H>*u_Q=(Y^dagger dot Z) dot X+Y^dagger dot (Z dot X) (node 1.2), but the registered amplified column-Hilbert display may be applied to a second argument V only after V is known to lie in M_{n,1} tensor S_{P,Q}. None of def-ha-map, def-hcb-datum, lem-compcb-amplified-compression-identities, or lem-hcb-column-hilbert-squared proves V=Z dot X has that membership. Hence <Y,H-Z dot X> in the root is not typed by the allowed data, and the subtraction in node 1.4 is invalid. The root cannot be proved as contracted. A mathematically valid repair must either (i) add an allowed lemma asserting S_{P,R} dot S_{R,Q} subset S_{P,Q} at every amplification, after which the column-Hilbert display gives Y^dagger dot (Z dot X)=<Y,Z dot X>*u_Q and subtraction from node 1.2 proves the root, or (ii) change the contract to use a specified target-corner compression of Z dot X and prove the corresponding pairing identity. Without one of these contract/dependency changes, node 1 must be rejected rather than accepted.
